name: Bowling Night
hook: Curve it into the pocket. Everyone watches the pins fly.
how: Take turns bowling ten frames on one lane with real strikes, spares and a three-ball tenth. Line the ball up, swipe it down the lane and curve your swipe to hook it.
controls: Drag sideways to line up, swipe up to roll, curve the swipe for spin (mouse or finger)
uses: Each player's highest game, shown on the results card.
The host's browser checks each roll, counts the pins and keeps the score sheet; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots bowl in the empty seats, and take over for anyone who leaves.
Every roll plays out for everyone at once, pin for pin.
ideas: Add bumpers in the gutters for beginners
Make it cosmic bowling with glowing pins and a disco ball
Add a bonus round where the pins are arranged in a line
